name: Pipedream
summary: Pipedream Connect lets developers embed integrations with 3,000+ APIs in their own apps and agents, with Pipedream running the OAuth flows and storing and refreshing each user's tokens. Its 10,000+ prebuilt actions and triggers are available through SDKs and a remote MCP server. Pipedream also offers a workflow automation product.
facts: Managed OAuth with automatic token refresh
TypeScript, Python, Java SDKs; remote MCP server
Free in development; Startup from $99/month (annual) for production
External users plus credits per 30 s of compute
goodFor: Embedding user-facing integrations in a product
Running custom code next to prebuilt actions
watchOut: Production requires a paid plan billed per external user
Component registry is source-available, not open source
